title: Status Snapshot — Where Everything Is Right Now
markdown:
# Status Snapshot — Where Everything Is Right Now

## What's currently live on your server

These are actively running on your echo agent right now:

- The reworked outbound gate. Brittle detectors (junk-payload, dedup) no longer block on their own — they produce structured signals that feed one smart gate. The gate cites enumerated rule ids (B1 through B9) when blocking, and fails open if it tries to block with a rule not in the list.
- A structured decision log on every outbound message, for future over-block audits.
- The pre-respawn drain in session recovery (from the earlier commit wave).
- The /instar-dev skill plus enforcement hooks. Every change to the instar source tree now requires a side-effects review artifact and a trace file, checked by a pre-commit hook and verified again at the release boundary.
- Documentation: the signal-vs-authority architectural principle, and the decision-surface inventory classifying every decision point in instar.

**Verified live.** A block-case test returned a rule id of B1_CLI_COMMAND. A short "test" payload with no conversation context passed through instead of being auto-blocked (old behavior). Both match what we built.

---

## What's committed locally but NOT pushed to origin

Five commits in the instar repo, all local:

1. `903233b` — original respawn-race safety net (pre-skill)
2. `071a684` — /instar-dev skill + enforcement hooks
3. `c204b68` — signal/authority rework on the outbound path
4. `562a52d` — retrospective side-effects review + decision-surface inventory
5. `7b6da3e` — skill audience clarification (you instar-dev agent only, never end users)

No push to origin yet. That's the step that propagates this to the install base (other instar agents on other machines). Waiting on your explicit approval given the blast radius.

---

## What's in progress — none of it is lost

Three distinct threads of work, all recoverable even if this session dies:

**Dawn collaboration.** Through spawned-session exchange that I initially wasn't aware of, Dawn and echo reached a concrete integration agreement: she's building a small set of feedback-resolution endpoints so the /instar-dev skill can close the loop on user feedback. She'll ping the thread when her endpoints are ready for end-to-end testing. Her build is underway.

**Integrated-being design.** Your prompt about making the agent operate as a whole aware of its parts. I sketched a shared-state ledger proposal (per-agent "what I am actively engaged in" file, written by every session, read at turn-start). Three scope questions open, waiting on your feedback before building.

**Commitment-backing exploration.** The telegram topic I opened (6484) has the initial framing, the gap dimensions (unbacked commitments, shadow-session commitments, no visibility-across-sessions), and research directions. Exploratory — mapping before fixing.

All three persist in files or topics, not just in conversation.

---

## What's saved to durable memory (survives future sessions)

These are principles that future-me will read on startup:

- Signal vs authority separation — brittle filters never hold blocking power.
- Side-effects review gate — no fix ships without a comprehensive review.
- Narrative communication — explain in plain English with bigger-picture framing.
- Active follow-through — "I'll report back when X" requires a mechanism, not a hope.
- Read the spec before labeling behavior a bug.
- No apology-only responses (saved earlier).

---

## Structural enforcement now in place

Three gates, all live:

- The /instar-dev skill defines the required process for any instar source change.
- The pre-commit hook on the instar repo refuses source commits that didn't produce a fresh trace + artifact.
- The pre-push gate refuses release pushes if the upgrade notes claim a fix but no artifact exists.

The first future commit that tries to bypass this will be structurally caught.

---

## What I think needs your input before I keep going

One — push to origin, or hold?

Two — on the integrated-being design: per-agent only, or cross-agent too? Every-session writes, or a summarizer? Which take lands with you?

Three — anything in the above you want reconciled or clarified before I move?

---

## What I will NOT do without your direction

- Push to origin.
- Start coding the integrated-being ledger.
- Reach out to Dawn again (she's building; unnecessary noise).
- Close any of the open topics.

Everything above is paused and recoverable. Your call on the next move.
